name: C7-shared-profile
description: Plan 8.4 C7: several agents on one profile and one token, to reach the per-profile limits that C1 does not reach (each C1 agent has its own profile). Agent i writes to agentFileIds[i] from the setup vars file, 50 small writes each at 10 per second. Run with --agents 10 or more, and a tokens file that repeats the one token on every line. Compare the errors, the climit queue and the p95 with C1 at the same agent count.

steps.name: small write to the file of this agent
